name: Gyakuten Saiban in Joypolis
summary: Gyakuten Saiban in Joypolis is a location-based Ace Attorney adventure created for Tokyo Joypolis. Players investigate original murder cases by moving between terminals throughout the venue, questioning witnesses and collecting evidence before returning to the courtroom area to defend the accused against Miles Edgeworth. The attraction contains three original cases set in Tokyo Joypolis.
